object.title: Nonnegativity conjecture for the cd-index of regular CW spheres
object.statement: A regular CW sphere is a regular CW complex whose underlying space is a sphere, and its $cd$-index is the polynomial $\Phi_P(c,d)$ encoding its flag $f$-vector, with $c$ of degree $1$ and $d$ of degree $2$. **Nonnegativity conjecture.** The coefficients in the $cd$-index of every regular CW sphere are nonnegative. This extends the nonnegativity known for convex polytopes to all regular CW spheres; the source gives no resolution of the conjecture.
object.source_name: Margaret M. Bayer, “The cd-Index: A Survey”, arXiv:1901.04939 (2020).
object.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1901.04939

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2019).
